AveragePartyHPLessOrEqual: Avg Party HP to be less than or equal to:
BuffOnlyDont: If you are NOT one of the jobs that regularly damage buffs themselves, or do not party up in OC, then this will SKIP using Phantom Abilities until burst time is detected (which might be never on a buff-less job)!
BuffOnlyList: DRK, PLD, WAR, AST, MNK, DRG, NIN, BRD, are the only jobs this is likely to be a good option for
BuffOnlyNotRecommended: Many jobs do not have self buffs that are up regularly, many burst phases cannot accommodate extra Phantom Abilities, and many Phantom Abilities are up more often than this on would be on many jobs!
SliderShouldBeLow: The slider value should be rather low, if you do use it!
VeryCostly: This is a VERY costly Feature!
